annotations.title: Instagram identities a Meta ad account can run ads as

description: action accounts (default): the Instagram accounts a Meta ad account can run ads as (connected to the ad account, its Instagram accounts, and the Instagram account or Page-backed account of each Page it promotes), each with the id create_meta_ad takes as instagramUserId. action posts (igUserId): that account's posts, newest first, each id usable as create_meta_ad boostPostId with boostTarget "instagram" (whether Meta says it can be boosted is shown when Meta reports it); no separate Instagram connection is needed. A source that could not be read is named, never counted as none. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

igUserId.description: posts: the Instagram account id from action accounts
